items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: I played drums in there with him for about three weeks.

ctx.x: Right. Right. Well, I played drums in there with him for about three weeks. Who else was in the band looking at? Well, at that time I remember Buddy Pity, a Trombone player called George Washington, was in the band then. He had a piano player in the band,
Walter DeCoult. Well, I knew him. He was a piano at that time.
And I think a clarinet player you called Big Eye Louie. That's all I knew, Big Eye Louie.
